items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: That was when Fletcher Henderson was just beginning to get prominent back then in 23. And it was a dancing school. In other words, it was a taxi dance that Roseland Ballroom was at that time and they were alternating with the Fletcher Henderson band.

ctx.x: Did he ever say how the band was received up there? Write letters back or anything?

He wrote and said the band was, well, it was a different style playing all together than what they were playing up there because they were alternating in the Roseland Ballroom at the time. That was when Fletcher Henderson was just beginning to get prominent back then in 23. And it was a dancing school. In other words, it was a taxi dance that Roseland Ballroom was at that time and they were alternating with the Fletcher Henderson band. And of course there was two different styles of playing all together,…
